authority_note: worker evidence only; may not set status=done, validation_status=passed, an adoption, a detector-of-record, or any gate verdict
subject: Byte-exact reconstructability census of the three candidate class-separation detector hashes from recorded copies on disk. Directly supplies the first acceptance clause and the stop rule of assignment astra-classsep-stabilize-0118 (reconstruct and hash c266dbec, a8c04fc3, e36b0d64 from recorded copies; if no candidate can be reconstructed byte-exactly, record unresolved detector contest and keep G-AUDIT pending).

enumeration_rule.include: regular files whose basename matches glob 'class_separation*.py'
enumeration_rule.exclude: any path with a __pycache__ component or a .pyc suffix; symlinks are not followed
enumeration_rule.note: the rule is fixed here before the recorded run; it captures canonical, artifacts/worker-*/pinned, runtime evidence and tmp sandbox copies under the same name family

hash_rule: sha256 over the entire file, streamed; byte-exact means hexdigest equality with the candidate constant

exactness: EXACT:<label> when digest equals one of the three candidate constants
OTHER_KNOWN when digest equals the recorded superseded arms e2d24b927ee8 or dc8aa0de3869 (full hashes read from reviews/CLASSSEP-calibration-adjudication.json if present, else literal prefixes below)

provenance_class.third_party_pinned: path starts with artifacts/ and not worker049_own

verdict_rules.per_candidate: BYTE_EXACT_COPIES_PRESENT iff >=1 enumerated file digests to the candidate constant, else NO_BYTE_EXACT_COPY
verdict_rules.primary_copy: PRIMARY_PRE_DRIFT_COPY_PRESENT iff an EXACT copy has temporal_bin in {before_freeze, freeze_to_drift}
verdict_rules.stop_rule_mapping: if any of the three candidates is NO_BYTE_EXACT_COPY the stabilize-0118 stop rule is TRIGGERED for that candidate; only if all three are NO_BYTE_EXACT_COPY would it be GLOBALLY_TRIGGERED. This packet reports the mapping; it does not decide the contest.
verdict_rules.no_adoption: the census does not name a detector-of-record and does not rank candidates by semantics; hashes only

controls: C1 positive: at least one enumerated file digests to each candidate label that has any copy at all (guards against an empty walk)
C2 negative: a one-byte-truncated byte string of the live detector file must not digest to the live constant
C3 pin: the live detector file at run start must digest to live_detector_expected
C4 pin: the map active frozen_artifacts pin must equal map_active_pin_expected
C5 rule: no census row may end with .pyc or contain a __pycache__ component
C6 immutability: live detector and preserved void evidence re-hash unchanged at run end

exit_codes.0: census complete, all pin checks and controls pass
exit_codes.2: PIN_MISMATCH: a fixed input moved or a control failed
exit_codes.3: NONDETERMINISTIC: the two in-process census passes differ
exit_codes.4: IMMUTABILITY_VIOLATION: a pinned input changed during the run

falsifier: Re-run run_detector_record_049.py at the pins: any fixed-input mismatch (exit 2), a nondeterministic double census (exit 3), an immutability violation (exit 4), a candidate reported BYTE_EXACT_COPIES_PRESENT whose only copies are not byte-identical, a candidate reported NO_BYTE_EXACT_COPY while any enumerated file digests to it, or a census row outside the pre-registered enumeration rule falsifies this packet.
